states: Private mock-mode stack built from this tree (backend :7745, Vite :5265), headless Chromium via Playwright with clipboard read/write granted.

Pods table Pod name cron-nightly-backfill-28918234, Pods table Node column prod-euw1-k8s-03 and Workload controllers name nightly-backfill-28918234 at both widths. At 768 px the pod and controller heads truncate (cron-ni… -28918234) and the tails stay visible, unchanged from before the fix.
